`check` knows Divide, Float, Decimal, Integer, Near, Text, Round, Keys, HasKey and IsEmpty, which haro.exe runs

a name haro.exe does not answer is still undefined: one letter off a built-in, one off a native
a .ring file reaches the natives too, and `check` knows them there

`check` knows every one of the 283 names the compiler's table and the spelling table name, as written today (Eval, LoadLib and the calls that admit code apart: any one switches the rule off for its file, as it always has)
text + an integer literal: `check` says NO_COERCION where the run refuses it
a t name + an i name: the letters show it, and `check` says NO_COERCION
text + String(i) is text + text: no finding, and the run prints it
a name lettered x shows no type: `check` says nothing, and the run still refuses it -- what stays
a d name + an f name: `check` says NUMBER_MIX where the run refuses it
an f name * an integer literal: NUMBER_MIX in `check` and in the run
an f name * Float(3) is two floats: no finding, and the run prints it
inside a function as at the top level: a t local + an i local is NO_COERCION in `check`
1 / 3 has no exact decimal: `check` says DECIMAL_INEXACT where the run refuses it
1 / 4 is exactly 0.25: no finding, and the run prints it
a quotient given to an i name, even 10 / 5: `check` says TYPE_LETTER where the run refuses it
10 / 5 given to a d name: no finding, and the run prints 2
a quotient of two names: their values are the run's, so `check` says nothing and the run still refuses 1 / 3 -- what stays
a quotient of two names given to an i name: the letter shows it whatever the values
a top-level `nL = 5` is refused when compiling, NAME_RESERVED, and `check` names it at the run's line
a top-level `tAb` is refused the same: it would replace the tab every older file reads
a function's own `nL` is its local: no refusal, and the older file's line end is untouched
`nLines` is another name: no refusal
a top-level `nL` is refused in a file that loads no older file too: the name is reserved, wherever it would land
a .ring file reads as it did: its own `nl = "|"` replaces the line end, as it always has
a d name as an index: INDEX_NOT_INTEGER in `check` and in the run, naming the decimal
an f name as an index: INDEX_NOT_INTEGER, naming the float
a decimal literal as an index: INDEX_NOT_INTEGER
Integer(dI) is an integer: no finding, and the run prints b
an x name holding a decimal: `check` cannot see it, and the run names it -- INDEX_NOT_INTEGER, not "Bad parameter type!"
a decimal index written into is refused the same
